title: reconcile() have list is unbounded — sends entire group log history per sync
description: group_log/reconcile.rs BFS traverses all entries reachable from local tips and returns them all in ReconcileResult.have. For a 10k-article group this returns 10k LogEntryIds (~320 KB of raw IDs) per reconciliation round. Expected impact at scale: reconciliation becomes increasingly expensive as groups grow, with no cap. Subsequent protocol would need to filter which entries the remote actually wants. Fix options: cap have list at N tips only (remote fetches ancestors on demand), or implement a set-reconciliation sketch (Bloom filter or IBF), or document the current bounded behavior as an explicit design constraint.
